entry_name: ReadoutBench best estimate (registry model + model ensemble)
harness: No new model calls. For each trial: average the six Models-board entries' p_met on the log-odds scale; shift that average by one constant so its mean over the 548 trials equals the registry model's (B1) mean; then average it 50/50 with B1 on the log-odds scale. The recipe was chosen on the 111 pilot trials (out-of-sample Brier 0.145 against B1's 0.164) and fixed before publication; no Round 1 outcome was known.
